narratives.title: Geopolitical Escalation Fuels Risk-Off
narratives.summary: Capital is fleeing risk assets as multiple geopolitical flashpoints—Iran-US kinetic exchanges, Israel multi-front escalation, and Ukraine deep strikes—signal sustained conflict. The market consensus underestimates escalation persistence, driving flows into safe havens and commodities.
narratives.trade_implication: Long gold, short S&P 500 futures; hedge with VIX calls.

narratives.title: Oil Supply Disruption Premiums
narratives.summary: Capital is rotating into oil and energy assets as the Hormuz blockade persists through Q3 2026, SPR releases signal bullish supply tightness, and pipeline bypass discussions indicate structural disruption. Markets misread SPR as bearish, but actual flows show accumulation.
narratives.trade_implication: Long WTI crude futures and energy sector ETFs; short refined product spreads.

narratives.title: Crypto as Macro Risk Proxy
narratives.summary: Bitcoin's crash mirrors broad risk-off moves, not crypto-specific weakness, as institutional de-risking and whale accumulation indicate a macro-driven selloff. Capital flows show dip-buying by long-term holders, suggesting a floor near $65K.
narratives.trade_implication: Accumulate Bitcoin on dips via futures; hedge with put spreads.
